definitions.gloss: former times; days of old; the past
definitions.explanation: A literary or formal word referring to times long past, often used when reflecting on how things used to be.

examples.japanese: {昔日|せきじつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面影|おもかげ}→面影：06631_omokage⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There is no trace of what it once was.

examples.japanese: {昔日|せきじつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{栄光|えいこう}→栄光：20495_eikou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{偲|しの}ぶ→偲ぶ：30130_shinobu⟧。
examples.english: To look back fondly on past glories.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{城跡|しろあと}→城跡：16199_shiroato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{昔日|せきじつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{壮大|そうだい}→壮大：10900_soudai⟧さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じさせる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧もの⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: These castle ruins evoke the grandeur of former times.

notes:
A literary, formal word used primarily in written Japanese. Almost always appears in set phrases like {昔日|せきじつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面影|おもかげ}→面影：06631_omokage⟧ (trace of former days) or {昔日|せきじつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{栄光|えいこう}→栄光：20495_eikou⟧ (past glory). Conveys a sense of nostalgia or reflection on how much has changed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {昔日|せきじつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面影|おもかげ}→面影：06631_omokage⟧: traces of former days
- {昔日|せきじつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{栄光|えいこう}→栄光：20495_eikou⟧: past glory
- {昔日|せきじつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{偲|しの}ぶ→偲ぶ：30130_shinobu⟧: to reminisce about the past
- {昔日|せきじつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧: the form it once had

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧: long ago; the past — the everyday word for the past, used in conversation and stories
- {往時|おうじ}: former times — similarly literary, but emphasizes a specific past era
- {古|いにしえ}: ancient times — even more literary and poetic, referring to very distant history
